profile.name: Arish Ahmad
profile.headline:
Thoughtful code.
Useful experiences.
profile.intro: I’m Arish, a full-stack developer and BCA student turning ideas into practical web experiences with the MERN stack.
profile.about: I enjoy connecting the pieces: a clear interface, a dependable API, and well-organized data. My work spans a team-built career guidance platform, a Java student management system, and a Python game. I’m studying Computer Applications at Integral University, where I’m also involved in technical and student communities.

projects.title: CareerUp AI
projects.summary: A career guidance platform that brings profiles and a career-focused dashboard into one place.
projects.description: Built as part of a five-member team, connecting a React frontend with a Node.js and Express backend and MongoDB storage.
contributions: Implemented user authentication and profile management.
Contributed to frontend and backend development and integrated application components.
Collaborated with a five-member team using Git and GitHub.

projects.title: Student Management System
projects.summary: An organized approach to student records, built on object-oriented programming.
projects.description: A Java application for managing student records and common student management operations.
contributions: Applied object-oriented principles to organize application logic and improve maintainability.

projects.title: Snake Game
projects.summary: A classic game exploring movement, collision detection, and event-driven controls.
projects.description: A Python implementation of Snake with movement, scoring, collision detection, and game-over logic.
contributions: Built movement, collision detection, scoring, and game-over logic.
Used functions, loops, conditional logic, and event-driven controls.
